variants.headline: Looking back: home world raises its demands
variants.sub: The demands placed on the colony by the home world have increased.
variants.body:
We return to {first_reported}. Our report recorded this: The home world had raised what it demands of the colony.

The gazette notes the increase as a change in the demands placed upon the colony. The existence of a higher requirement should be kept distinct from any assumption about its particulars. An administrative account is most useful when it describes the known obligation without supplying terms not established by the notice.

The event remains part of the record. Whether subsequent developments met the standard it raised is a separate question, not something the old headline can answer by itself.

This paper examines {target} through the increased demand, without presuming either its justification or its practical burden. The change is established; its unreported terms should remain outside the factual account.
